execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."balance_purchase" (
  "amount_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "payment_intent_id" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "balance_purchase_status_check_e32ef9ef" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'EXPIRED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."model_pricing" (
  "cents_per_1k_input" numeric NOT NULL,
  "cents_per_1k_output" numeric NOT NULL,
  "display_name" text NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "is_default" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."token_usage" (
  "actual_cost_cents" numeric,
  "amount_cents" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "input_tokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "job_id" text NOT NULL,
  "job_kind" text NOT NULL,
  "model" text NOT NULL,
  "openrouter_generation_ids" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "output_tokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "token_usage_job_kind_check_74df029d" CHECK ("job_kind" IN ('SUGGESTION', 'TAILOR')),
  CONSTRAINT "token_usage_openrouter_generation_ids_elem_not_null_73635ad0" CHECK (array_position("openrouter_generation_ids", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "auth0_id" text NOT NULL,
  "balance_cents" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "full_name" text,
  "has_onboarded" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "phone" text,
  "site_admin" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "stripe_customer_id" text,
  "summary" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("auth0_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_base_education" (
  "degree" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "end_date" text,
  "field_of_study" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "institution" text NOT NULL,
  "start_date" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_base_experience" (
  "company_name" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "end_date" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "start_date" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_base_experience_bullet" (
  "bullet" text NOT NULL,
  "bullet_order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "user_experience_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_base_project" (
  "description" text,
  "end_date" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "link" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "start_date" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_base_skill" (
  "category" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_generated_resume" (
  "generated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "s3_key" text NOT NULL,
  "source_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "template" text DEFAULT 'original' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_resume_format" (
  "captured_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "format" text NOT NULL,
  "source_job_id" text,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_social_link" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "link" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_social_link_type_check_91780aba" CHECK ("type" IN ('LINKEDIN', 'GITHUB', 'WEBSITE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_suggestion" (
  "bullet_id" int4,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "experience_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "model" text,
  "pending_question" text,
  "result" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PROCESSING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_suggestion_status_check_8152fec2" CHECK ("status" IN ('PROCESSING', 'WAITING_FOR_INPUT', 'COMPLETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_tailor_run" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "job_description" text NOT NULL,
  "model" text,
  "pending_question" text,
  "result" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PROCESSING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_tailor_run_status_check_fa868dec" CHECK ("status" IN ('PROCESSING', 'WAITING_FOR_INPUT', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_upload_job" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "s3_key" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_upload_job_status_check_48358bb5" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED'))
)
